subject: Medford Jazz Festival 2025 Sunday Performances
overview: The final day of the 2025 Medford Jazz Festival featured performances by the Berklee Institute of Jazz and Gender Justice and the George Russell Jr. Trio with Donna McElroy. Organizers concluded the three-day event with acknowledgments of local sponsors, volunteers, and the West Medford Community Center.

items.title: Opening Remarks and Acknowledgments
items.summary: Jonathan Fagan opened the final day of the festival by thanking community partners, sponsors, and Medford Community Media.

items.title: Recap of Festival Performances
items.summary: Terry Carter summarized the student performances from Friday and the Brazilian jazz and Ally Project sets from Saturday.

items.title: Berklee Institute of Jazz and Gender Justice Performance
items.summary: The Berklee Institute of Jazz and Gender Justice, led by Ivana Cuesta, performed a set featuring compositions by women and non-binary artists.

items.title: Intermission and Community Announcements
items.summary: The festival held a brief intermission for equipment changeover while organizers highlighted donation stations and local vendors.

items.title: George Russell Jr. and Donna McElroy Introduction
items.summary: Terry Carter introduced the afternoon's second act, featuring vocalist Donna McElroy and pianist George Russell Jr.

items.title: George Russell Jr. and Donna McElroy Performance
items.summary: The ensemble performed a set of jazz standards and original compositions by Donna McElroy, concluding the performance with an encore of 'Misty'.

items.title: Final Remarks and Festival Conclusion
items.summary: Jonathan Fagan and Terry Carter closed the festival with final thanks to the West Medford Community Center and participating musicians.
